events.title: Socialist Night School: Abolition 101
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description: This workshop moves beyond a US-centric view of abolition to explore the global systems of policing, imprisonment, and surveillance that uphold racial capitalism and imperialism. We will connect the struggle to abolish police and prisons in Philadelphia to movements for liberation around the world, understanding that our fights are interconnected. By building internationalist prisoner solidarity, we strengthen our local organizing and embrace a truly intersectional abolitionist framework

events.title: Solidarity through bars (downstairs)
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description:
You’re invited to join our new group, SOLIDARITY THROUGH BARS, a @prisonercorrespondenceproject 

Are you looking for…
* a way to make a positive impact in the world?
* a community of abolitionists?
* a dedicated time to write, craft, talk, think, connect?

Join our letter-writing collective to reach our community members currently imprisoned by the state. 

Options for queer people to establish long-term correspondence with queer prisoners AND for anyone to drop in for one-off letters of encouragement to political prisoners. 

Materials provided - no funds or personal address needed!

Every last Saturday of the month @ 2pm

704 South St, Philly - DOWNSTAIRS!!!

Accessibility Statement: The Wooden Shoe is ADA accessible excepting the restroom and meetings marked “downstairs”. All events are masked (provided) and an air filter runs in the space. Parking is available metered on the street with the two closest paid parking garages at 1457 South St and 545 S 11th St. Public transit bus lines 45 & 47 stop within short walking distance. ASL interpretation available upon advanced request. Please let us know if you have any other accessibility requirements and we will do our best to accommodate.

All events are free, no RSVP required.

events.title: Non-Compliant: A Night of Queer Disabled Poetry Presents "Spells To Turn You Into A Transgender Communist"
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description: Doctors hate 'em, but you'll love 'em! Non-Compliant is BACK with another night full of local queer disabled poets!!! Commune with fellow krips and spoonies and celebrate spooky season with incantations to abolish the evil forces of the medical industrial complex and ye olde ableism
